text: ねえねえ　おおきさ　はからせて！

structure.jp: おおきさ　はからせて！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: せる on a verb means letting or making someone do it. With て at the end it becomes a request to be allowed. はからせて = 'let me measure'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a casual request, a short ください. はからせて = 'let me measure, please'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ swapped for the final い of a describing word turns it into a thing you can measure. おおきさ = 'bigness, size'.
